title: Dallas Bond Program Projects
description: Use this service request for general inquiries concerning Dallas Bond Program Projects. ** For questions regarding the 2017 Bond Program Click Here For updates on the upcoming 2024 Bond Projects Click Here ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 15 business days. Note: For construction concerns or construction site complaints, see Code Concern (Noise Complaint) or Construction Site Complaint.

observedQuestions.branchFinding: All options showed the same remaining questions

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request with a question or proposed Dallas Bond Program project.
actions.why: To make a general inquiry about Dallas Bond Program Projects or propose a project. The 311 request form asks whether the question concerns alleys, drainage or erosion control, sidewalks, streets, thoroughfares, or another bond project, and asks for project details.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Dallas Bond Program Projects" requests does not apply to construction concerns or construction-site complaints. If the concern is construction noise, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead. If the concern is a construction-site complaint, then submit a "Construction Site Complaint" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Dallas Bond Program Projects"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Dallas Bond Program Projects"

actions.tagline: Visit the City of Dallas Bond Program website for 2017 Bond Program information.
actions.why: For questions regarding the 2017 Dallas Bond Program. The description for "Dallas Bond Program Projects" requests on the Dallas 311 website points to a "Click Here" link for these questions.
actions.how: Use the 2017 Bond Program "Click Here" link in the Dallas 311 service description
actions.how_formatted: Use the 2017 Bond Program "Click Here" link in the Dallas 311 service description

actions.tagline: Visit the City of Dallas Bond Program website for 2024 Bond Project updates.
actions.why: For updates on the upcoming 2024 Dallas Bond Projects. The description for "Dallas Bond Program Projects" requests on the Dallas 311 website points to a separate "Click Here" link for those updates.
actions.how: Use the 2024 Bond Projects "Click Here" link in the Dallas 311 service description
actions.how_formatted: Use the 2024 Bond Projects "Click Here" link in the Dallas 311 service description

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about construction noise.
actions.why: For a construction noise concern. The description for "Dallas Bond Program Projects" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs construction concerns to Code Concern (Noise Complaint), and the saved "Code Concerns" 311 request form includes noise among its nuisance issue options.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a construction-site complaint.
actions.why: For a construction-site concern such as trash or debris left by crews, missing erosion control, or mud tracked into the street. The description for "Dallas Bond Program Projects" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs construction-site complaints to this service.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Construction Site Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Construction Site Complaint"
